I will buy DAP and urea from the cooperative like last season, though fertilizer prices are high so I cannot apply as much as the extension agent recommends. I also spread manure from our animals before plowing because it helps the soil hold moisture. My husband and older children help me with weeding and harvest, but for threshing I will need to hire a few neighbors to finish quickly before the rains spoil the grain.
